# Real speech QA fixture

`de-guten-tag.oga` is the single recording obtained from https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/7a/De-Guten_Tag.oga. Its file page is https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:De-Guten_Tag.oga (oldid 888223486). The uploader is Beagle Beck; the source explicitly marks authorship/own work as assumed. The uploader dedicates the work to the public domain worldwide and grants unconditional any-purpose use as fallback. This is evidence of the uploader's rights statement, not an independent investigation of the performer.

Original SHA-1: `3dc278525db3705517a0202f22948a3b6f64da77`, verified against Commons metadata at acquisition on 2026-10-03. Original length: 116416 frames at 44100 Hz, 2.639818594 seconds. `de-guten-tag.wav` is decoded PCM16 WAV using libsndfile via soundfile 0.14.0; it preserves the full recording without cuts or invented fine timing. The whole recording maps by construction to the exact conventional greeting in `de-guten-tag.text.json`.

This sample demonstrates ingestion/binding/playback/logging. It is not a connected listening curriculum, a native quality review, or B2 evidence. Recording quality is `machine_checked`, with no human review or mastery granted. No production course audio is acquired by this fixture. Text follows the ordinary corpus import path and is not an audio-only duplicate corpus.
